race.description: Sportsbet Fixed Odds Exotics F&M (Bm74) Hcp
race.comment: We kick off proceedings with a tricky little sprint for the girls. CUSTOM (3) is one of a few 3yo fillies taking on the older mares but returned with an encouraging second here giving away weight and coming close on the line. She can improve off that and gets in nicely after the claim. TAKEKO (1) ran well fresh here over 1100m behind a few sharper ones. Comes back a notch in grade here and the rise to 1200m second up should suit much better having won a trial between runs. DIVINE THOUGHTS (4) has won two on the bounce in easier company and deserves a crack in a race like this. She'll be up on speed and can run well at odds. RECUPERATO (5) was solid in the Creswick Stakes last time which ties in with CUSTOM through Afterberna. She'll take holding out. MYSTERY 'N' DRAMA (7) resumes having last run third to Sheza Albi. Barrier 10 here though and 1200m is firmly on the sharp side, watch the market.
